_comment: DRAFT - do not publish as-is.
The production ruleset is currently broken (presence/typing have no .read,
block has no self .read, the published copy is truncated) and the Publish
button is not reachable from this session. Merge the `forum` subtree below
into the fixed chat rules, then publish from the Console or the Admin SDK.
Shape enforced here:
forum/counts/<topicId>          number      public counter
forum/<cat>/<topicId>           {t,b,u,n,ts}  staff write, members read
forum/<cat>/<topicId>/r/<rid>   {t,u,n,ts}    author writes, staff deletes
forum/votes/<topicId>/<uid>     true          own uid only, toggle
forum/read/<uid>/<topicId>      ts            own uid only
forum/reports/<rid>             {t,u,ts,why}  member creates, staff reads
forum/pending/<pid>             {..,state}    member asks, staff approves
forum/staff/<uid>               {n,ts}        NOT writable from any client
forum/rate/<uid>/<bucket>       ts            one write per uid per 20s window
No Cloud Functions on the Spark plan, so `rate` is the throttle: a bucket key
can only be created once, and the other write paths require the matching
bucket to already exist. That caps a member at one write per 20s window
without needing a server.
To bootstrap staff, write it from the Console or the Admin SDK, e.g.
firebase.database().ref('forum/staff/<uid>').set({ n: 'Kaz', ts: 0 })
and give that account the custom claim used below.
